description: This file provides functions to infer Azure credential types from environment variables and to obtain an Azure AD token provider based on the inferred or specified credential type. It manages different credential configurations for Azure authentication workflows.

methods.name: infer_credential_type_from_environment
methods.description: Determines the Azure credential type based on environment variables.

methods.name: get_azure_ad_token_provider
methods.description: Returns a callable that provides an Azure AD token, configured based on environment variables or specified credential type.
